title: Load a tube furnace for MoS2 growth by thermal CVD and cap the tube
instruction: Load the three boats into the tube for MoS2 growth by thermal CVD, in the right places for the gas flow and the heat, rack the push rod and cap both ends of the tube.
context: Placing precursors along a furnace's temperature profile decides whether MoS2 grows; it takes the chemistry, pushing boats blind along a tube with a rod, and sealing both ends.
setup: A split-tube furnace, 370 x 280 mm, lid open, on the bench, with a thermocouple tip at its chamber's centre. In it a fixed fused-quartz tube, 50.8 mm OD, 46 mm ID, 610 mm long, both end caps off: each lies in a cradle beside its end, its open end towards the tube's line (the argon inlet's cap beyond the boat tray, away from the robots; the exhaust's cap at the far end, nearer the robots). Each cap is a stainless cup, 62 mm OD and 25 mm deep, 0.1 kg, with a hose barb and a flat tab 28 x 22 x 5 mm behind it to hold it by. Beside the near end, a stainless tray holds three loose boats side by side, each with a 5 mm square tongue at its back: an alumina boat 60 x 20 x 12 mm with 4 mm of yellow sulfur powder, 12 g; an alumina boat 60 x 20 x 12 mm with 4 mm of pale MoO3 powder, 12 g; a quartz boat 35 x 20 x 12 mm, 6 g, holding a 10 x 10 x 0.5 mm SiO2/Si chip face up. On a rack of two V rests beside the tube's line, nearer the robots, lies a fused-quartz push rod: a tube 8 mm OD and 218 mm long, 15 g, with a flat paddle on its front, 4 mm thick, 12 mm tall and 14 to 20 mm wide, and a flat ring 40 mm across and 5 mm thick on its back end to hold it by.
scoring: 0 if any boat tips over 20 degrees or drops 30 mm, or the chip tilts over 30 degrees or its centre leaves the inside of its boat, at any time; 0 unless the boats, chip, rod and caps moved under 1 mm in the last second. Otherwise 0.2 for each boat in the tube on its floor and in place: sulfur centred within 15 mm of 10 mm inside the furnace's near (upstream) end; MoO3 centred within 10 mm of the thermocouple; the chip boat's centre 50 to 80 mm downstream of the MoO3 boat's. And 0.1 for each cap seated on its end of the tube: its end plate within 4 mm of the tube's end, within 3 mm of the tube's axis and 5 degrees of square. 1.0 if all three boats and both caps, the rod back on its rack (within 15 mm of its start) and every fingertip 8 cm or more from the rod, the boats and the caps.
reset_notes: Put the boats back on the tray, the rod on its rack and the caps in their cradles; the powders and the chip are reused.
fidelity: Rigid-body sim. Furnace, tube, tray, rack and cradles are fixed; boats, chip, rod and caps are loose with real sizes and masses, except the chip at 0.4 g (4x real). Powder is a solid layer, so spills are scored by tilt. No heat, gas or growth: the layout is scored from positions. Caps slip on (no O-ring); gas hoses not modelled. Quartz renders opaque: a boat in the tube shows only by the rod's depth.
